text.original: Built on local knowledge and honest advice

Prestige Realty was founded in 2011 by Sarah Whitman, a third-generation San Franciscan who was tired of watching friends get outbid by cash offers and confused by inconsistent advice. She built a small brokerage around one idea: agents should act like advisors, not salespeople.

Fifteen years later, our team of 32 agents has helped more than 2,300 households buy, sell, and invest across San Francisco, the Peninsula, and the East Bay. We're still independently owned, still local, and still answer our own phones.
Today, Prestige Realty is known for deep neighborhood expertise, a strong off-market network, and a support team that stays involved long after closing day.
Clear pricing guidance and honest timelines, even when the answer isn't what you hoped to hear.
Every agent specializes in specific Bay Area neighborhoods, not the whole map at once.
We measure success by referrals and repeat clients, not single transactions.
Prestige Realty sponsors local schools and housing-access nonprofits across the Bay Area.

How much does it cost to work with an agent as a buyer?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: In most cases, buyer representation is paid by the seller as part of the transaction, so there's no direct cost to you. We'll walk through the specifics during your consultation.
How long does it typically take to sell a home?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: Well-priced Bay Area homes in good condition typically go under contract within 2-3 weeks of listing, though timelines vary by neighborhood and season.
Do I need to be pre-approved before touring homes?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: We recommend getting pre-approved early so you can move quickly when you find the right home — we can connect you with trusted local lenders.
What areas does Prestige Realty serve?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: We serve San Francisco, the Peninsula (Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Redwood City), and the East Bay (Oakland, Berkeley, Alameda).

property-detail.html.title: Modern Family Home, Palo Alto | Prestige Realty

text.original: 482 Willow Creek Lane, Palo Alto, CA 94301

Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautifully updated home blends clean modern architecture with warm, livable spaces. The open-concept main floor features wide-plank oak flooring, a chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, and floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the living area with natural light. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a private balcony and a spa-inspired bathroom. The landscaped backyard offers a covered patio, mature fruit trees, and plenty of room to entertain — all within walking distance of top-rated Palo Alto schools.
